description: This file is a header file for the libwebsockets library, specifically defining service loop APIs such as lws_service() and related functions for handling WebSocket traffic. It contains function declarations, documentation, and macros related to the service mechanisms within the library.

methods.name: lws_service
methods.description: Service any pending websocket activity, handling new connections, incoming frames, and other events.

methods.name: lws_service_tsi
methods.description: Service activity on a specific thread service index, for multi-threaded scenarios.

methods.name: lws_cancel_service_pt
methods.description: Cancel the servicing of pending socket activity on a specific thread.

methods.name: lws_cancel_service
methods.description: Cancel wait for new pending socket activity on a given context, interrupting poll() or event loop.

methods.name: lws_service_fd
methods.description: Service a specific socket described by pollfd, handling any protocol events.

methods.name: lws_service_fd_tsi
methods.description: Service a socket in a specific thread service index.

methods.name: lws_service_adjust_timeout
methods.description: Check connections needing forced service and adjust poll timeout accordingly.
